items.title: SCHD Gets the Attention, but This Shareholder Yield ETF Measures Something Bigger
items.summary: SCHD draws billions in retiree money by promising steady dividends, but a rival fund quietly measures shareholder returns in a way that dividends alone can never capture. The difference in philosophy has produced a surprising decade-long performance gap worth understanding before you allocate.
